multiple_testing: Unadjusted per-test p-values; no familywise/FDR control is claimed. Sensitivity analyses do not select the preferred conclusion.

range.h1_method: Two-sided asymptotic Mann-Whitney U; tie correction and continuity correction; first group=BEV.
range.h2_method: Two-sided Spearman; asymptotic t approximation; all valid pairs and separate BEV/PHEV analyses.
range.quartiles: Linear interpolation on valid Range values.

cafv.unknown_label: Eligibility unknown as battery range has not been researched

county.h4a_primary: All 39 counties; Monte Carlo fixed-margin Pearson chi-square.
county.h4a_sensitivity: Exclude counties with fewer than 30 EV; use asymptotic chi-square only when all expected cells >=5, otherwise Monte Carlo.
county.h4b_sample_unit: Vehicle counts in each separate month; do not pool months as independent vehicles.

monte_carlo.sampling: SciPy random_table conditional on fixed row and column margins.
monte_carlo.df_reporting: Theoretical (rows-1)*(columns-1); SciPy resampling dof is not used.
monte_carlo.floor_interpretation: At the minimum estimate, report the finite simulation resolution, not p=0 or an upper bound on the true p-value.

p_underflow: When SciPy returns numerical zero, leave p_value empty, mark p_numerical_underflow and report <1e-300; no exact p=0 claim.
limitations: Administrative observational records do not establish causality.
Range availability differs by vehicle type and model year; valid Range records are not a complete representation of every group.
Statistical significance does not by itself measure business importance or justify policy effects.
